sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.2933/2025, first application under Section 389(1), Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant - Mohan (wrongly mentioned as Maahen).

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 06.09.2021 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Pandurna, District - Chhindwara (M.P.) in S.C. No.12/2020, whereby the appellant stands convicted for offences under Sections 366(A), 376 (ka) (kha) and 506 Part II of the IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 5 years (fine Rs.3,000/-), RI for Life (fine Rs.10,000/-) and 1 year (fine Rs.1,000/-) respectively with default stipulation that in lieu of payment of fine to further undergo additional RI for 3 months, 6 months and 1 month, respectively.
It is submitted by Ms. Sushma Bairagy, learned counsel for the appellant that the alleged incident had taken place on 21.01.2019 and the FIR was lodged on 08.02.2019.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Pandurna, District - Chhindwara (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: There is delay of about 20 days in filing the FIR.

It is pointed out that both prosecutrix and her mother (PW-1 and PW-2,
respectively) have admitted that grandfather was having about 4 acres of land which was not shared by grandfather to the prosecutrix and her mother but the same was given in totality to the present appellant.
Thus, it is pointed out 2 CRA-2668-2022 that on account of property dispute, the present appellant is falsely implicated.
It is further submitted that PW-4 Dr. Sharda Sharma, medical officer posted in Civil Hospital, Padurna admitted that due to rope skipping, etc. also hymen can be torn.

Thus, it is submitted that it is a case of false implication and it is prayed that benefit of suspension of sentence be extended to the present appellant.
Shri Manas Mani Verma, learned public prosecutor for the State, in his turn, submits that delay in lodging the FIR in family matters where the appellant is real uncle of the prosecutrix, is not unusual.
Secondly, it is submitted that doctor has categorically stated in paragraph 3 that hymen of the prosecutrix was torn and there was possibility of violation of her privacy in the recent past.
Reading evidence of PW-3 (Dr. Shikhar Khurana), Radiologist, it is pointed out that the age of the prosecutrix has come out to be 10-12 years.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, it is evident that no suggestion was given to the prosecutrix that she was skipping rope and got hurt and therefore her slacks etc. were blood stained to corroborate evidence of PW-4 (Dr. Sharda Sharma) as given by her in cross-examination.
In view of the facts of the case and evidence available on record, we are of the opinion that for the present no case for extending the benefit of suspension of sentence is made out.
Accordingly, I.A. No.2933/2025 fails and is dismissed.
List the appeal for final hearing as per its turn and seniority.
